description_en: Queries the pre-upgrade check report for a major engine version upgrade of an ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL or ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS MySQL及RDS PostgreSQL大版本升级前检查的检查报告
name: DescribeUpgradeMajorVersionPrecheckTask

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of records per page in the major engine version upgrade check report.

Valid values:
30 (default)
50
100
parameters.help_zh:
表示大版本升级前，检查报告每页显示的记录数。

取值范围：
30（默认值）
50
100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the pre-upgrade check report.

Valid values: a value greater than 0 that does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
表示显示升级前检查报告的页码。

取值范围：大于0且不超过Integer的最大值。默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The target instance version. The value must be greater than the current major engine version of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 目标实例版本。必须大于当前实例版本
parameters.name: target_major_version

parameters.help_en: The ID of the pre-upgrade check task. You can obtain this value from the TaskId response parameter after you call the UpgradeDBInstanceMajorVersionPrecheck operation to perform a pre-upgrade check
parameters.help_zh: 升级前检查任务ID，调用UpgradeDBInstanceMajorVersionPrecheck接口执行升级前检查后，从返回参数TaskId中获取
parameters.name: task_id

Items.description_en: The property list of the major engine version upgrade check report. Each attribute column contains the details of a check report entry
Items.description_zh: 大版本升级检查报告属性列表

items.description_en: The details of the major engine version upgrade check report
items.description_zh: 大版本升级检查报告详情

CheckTime.description_en:
The check time.

The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
CheckTime.description_zh:
检查时间。

以Unix时间戳表示。单位：毫秒

Detail.description_en: The content of the major engine version upgrade check report
Detail.description_zh: 大版本升级检查报告内容

EffectiveTime.description_en:
The expiration time of the check report.

The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
EffectiveTime.description_zh:
检查报告到期时间。

以Unix时间戳表示。单位：毫秒

RecommendDiskSize.description_en:
The recommended minimum disk capacity for the upgrade. Unit: GB.

This parameter is returned only for ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances
RecommendDiskSize.description_zh:
升级时，推荐的最小磁盘容量。单位：GB。

仅RDS PostgreSQL实例会返回该参数

RecommendLeastMemSize.description_en:
The recommended minimum memory for the upgrade. Unit: GB.

This parameter is returned only for ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances
RecommendLeastMemSize.description_zh:
升级时，推荐的最小内存。单位：GB。

仅RDS PostgreSQL实例会返回该参数

RecommendMemSize.description_en:
The recommended memory for the upgrade. Unit: GB.

If the memory of the instance is greater than or equal to the recommended memory, the upgrade is performed at the fastest speed to minimize the read-only duration of the instance.

This parameter is returned only for ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances
RecommendMemSize.description_zh:
升级时，推荐内存。单位：GB。

当实例的内存大于或等于推荐内存，将以最快的速度进行升级，以尽量减少实例的只读时间。

仅RDS PostgreSQL实例会返回该参数

Result.description_en:
The result of major engine version upgrade check.

Valid values:
Success: The check is passed.
Fail: The check failed.
warning: The check returned warnings. Review the report to determine whether to proceed with the upgrade.

If the check result is Fail, check the value of the Detail parameter, resolve the errors, and try again. For common errors and solutions, see [Understand major engine version upgrade check report for ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/218391.html）
Result.description_zh:
大版本升级检查的检查结果。

取值范围：
Success：成功
Fail：失败
warning：警告，需要查看报告，确定是否继续升级

当检查结果为Fail时，请排查Detail的参数取值，处理报错后再试，常见报错及处理方法，请参见[解读RDS PostgreSQL大版本升级检查报告]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/218391.html）

SourceMajorVersion.description_en: The current major engine version of the instance

TaskId.description_en: The node ID of the major engine version upgrade pre-check task
TaskId.description_zh: 大版本升级前检查任务ID

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The total number of entries in the upgrade check report
